# Brali LifeOS

> A local-first personal practice system for turning useful ideas into concrete actions, check-ins, and personal experiments that can be reviewed over time.

Brali's core loop is: choose -> practice -> review. The product combines a public Growth Library with planning, Focus sessions, challenges, check-ins, journals, time logs, and personal metrics so users can try a practice and keep their own record of what happened.

- Canonical website: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/
- Growth Library: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/life-os/
- Features: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/features/
- Getting started: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/docs/
- Privacy: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/privacy/
- Product facts: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/product-facts.json
- Growth Library datasets: https://brali-lifeos.github.io/life-os/datasets/

Brali app data is stored locally on the user device. The app includes backup, restore, and export tools. The static website does not use a login, contact form, advertising, or third-party analytics scripts.

The Growth Library contains practical guidance with different evidence maturity. Sensitive health and mental-health entries without explicit source review are kept out of search indexing until reviewed. The library should be interpreted as a set of starting points for personal practice, not as medical diagnosis or treatment guidance.
